name: CA-44
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Barragán with large financial advantage
Prediction markets price D win at ~97%
model.rationale: The baseline's D+24.9 margin is well supported by the D+20 lean, Barragán's incumbency and roughly 50-to-1 fundraising edge, and Polymarket pricing near 97%. No evidence justifies moving away from the model.
model.watch: Any late outside spending or a scandal shifting the environment could narrow the margin, though an upset remains very unlikely.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Nanette Barragán, the Democratic incumbent, is seeking another term in a Southern California district that leans about 20 points Democratic. She advanced to the general election and holds a commanding financial position, with more than $1 million on hand after raising roughly $786,000. Her Republican opponent, Genevieve Angel, has raised under $14,000 and shows no measurable outside support.

There are no public general-election polls or expert ratings for this race, so the forecast rests on fundamentals. The district's partisan lean, the incumbent's resources, and prediction markets pricing a Democratic win near 97% all point the same direction. A Democratic victory is the strong expectation, with the only real question being the size of the margin.
